messages.author: 30b406a9189eeb25
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] imgur
parts:
Thanks for supporting independent anonymous keys, I've registered my own.  Is there any way to see all images submitted under a given key? 

This just supports the anonymous API, not the authenticated API , which would I think allow one to submit to a personal collection on imgur.  not sure if that's useful, but looks straight forward.  i might give it a go if it's not already done (didn't see support for authentication in the imguR package either..)

-Carl
